claims.text: Macaw currently supports a command line interface, as well as mobile, desktop, and web applications.
Macaw has implemented a Telegram bot interface that allows multi-modal interactions including text, speech, image, and click.
The Telegram interface can be used across various devices and operating systems, including Android, iOS, Linux, Mac OS, and Windows.
